name: Cell and Molecular Biology PhD
detailsNote: Official information available; the December 1 Fall date is printed without a year, so it is not confirmed for Fall 2027. GRE policy, letters and funding guarantees are not stated on the pages opened, so they are left out. The fee shown is the international amount.
summary: Cell and molecular biology PhD within Molecular Biosciences at the University of Nevada, Reno. First-year students share a curriculum and rotate through at least two labs.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall application deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: Printed on the program page without a year. A Spring date of June 15 is also listed.

english.note: Academic IELTS. Official TOEFL or IELTS scores are required if your educational history is from a non-English-speaking country. Duolingo is not mentioned.

applicationFee.note: $95 for international applicants; $60 for domestic applicants. The pages do not mention fee waivers.

documents: Transcripts (unofficial copies for review; official copies required if recommended for admission)
requirements.note: Recommendation requests are generated automatically from the names and emails you enter. Applicants should have coursework in organic chemistry, biology, physics and calculus; deficiencies must be made up in the first year.

funding.note: Graduate fellowships are available on a competitive basis. Research and teaching assistantships exist; state-funded assistantships may be held for a maximum of five years for doctoral students. The pages do not state a stipend or whether funding covers international students.
